text:
[sys] 📺 Pattern Hunger. A sequence of foods. Eat them in the right order. The wrong order... disagrees with you.

The audience expects entertainment, not blood.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

The wrong order... disagrees with you. The audience knows the order. They are not telling.
🗣️ Nina to Rosa, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
🗣️ Chantal to Javier, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

◈ SYSTEM: "33. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 235 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
